[[File:Turoth icon.png|left]]
'''Turoths''' are Slayer monsters that require a [[Slayer]] level of 55 to kill. They frequently drop [[herb]]s and [[herb seed]]s. Turoths, like [[Kurasks]], must be killed with specific items for each combat style - [[leaf-bladed sword]] or [[leaf-bladed spear]] for melee; [[broad arrows]], [[broad bolts]], [[royal bolt]]s, or [[ascension bolt]]s for ranged; and a weapon that can cast [[Slayer Dart]] for magic. Necromancy does not affect Turoths.

Killing Turoths with [[seedicide]] set to destroy all seeds is a common method for [[Farming training#Active methods|active Farming training]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=July Quest Qol and Game Health Update - This Week In RuneScape|date=14 July 2025}}
** Added new sources for [[spirit weed seed|Spirit Weed Seeds]], [[inert adrenaline crystal|Inert Adrenaline Crystals]] and [[sirenic scale|Sirenic Scales]] across various [[Slayer]] monsters:
*** Spirit Weed seeds - [[Automaton (monster)|Automatons]], [[Strykewyrm]]s, Turoths, [[gemstone dragon|Gemstone Dragons]] (on task), [[brutisch dinosaur|Brutish Dinosaurs]], [[Grotworm]]s, [[moss giant|Moss Giants]], [[flesh crawler|Flesh Crawlers]], [[Cockatrice]]s, [[Kurask]] and [[seed drop table|Rare Seed Drop Table]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=March Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 March 2024}}
** Small Turoths had 42 Ranged instead of Attack, this has been corrected.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament & Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended, for example:
*** Turoths have been changed from ranged to melee monsters.
**** Life points decreased from 9,850 to 4,200.
**** Maximum hit decreased from 1,140 to 960.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (4 March 2013)|date=4 March 2013}}
** An issue with generic weapons causing damage to Turoths and [[Kurask]]s who should otherwise be immune has been fixed.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (11 December 2012)|date=11 December 2012}}
** Turoths no longer have incorrect stats.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (23 September 2009)|date=23 September 2009}}
** Fixed some ground near the turoths in the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Slayer Skill|date=26 January 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Turoths seem to have different ages which represents their combat level. The two lower-levelled turoths are pale white, while the remaining two have darker-coloured skin. These latter two also appear to have genders, as their examine texts refer to them as "he" and "she" rather than "it".
